rows.english:
Add up to 20 images with Android's file picker. The bottom tray shows thumbnails, filenames, image dimensions after cropping and any Same width or Same height adjustment, and file modification times when supplied by the provider. Sort by filename or modification time; sorting does not rearrange placed images.

Tap a thumbnail to select it. Crop image trims that image; Batch crop applies pixel or percentage margins to selected images. Drag crop handles or type amounts. Reset crop restores the original edges. Cropping is non-destructive and can be undone.

Hold a thumbnail, or drag an image already in the workspace, then drop it onto a highlighted edge. The translucent preview shows the exact snapped result. A right attachment aligns the tops; a bottom attachment aligns the left edges. You can also tap a thumbnail and then a + target. The first image starts at the origin. Attached images may move when their parent is cropped. Overlaps are rejected.

Same width and Same height give every input a common dimension while preserving each image's own aspect ratio. Choose pixels, percent, Smallest or Largest. Restore original sizes removes normalization and keeps crops.

Unplace returns only the selected image to the tray. Following images fill its gap; they stay placed. Remove deletes only that input. Undo/Redo restore these changes. Drag a placed image to rearrange it; empty-space dragging pans. Pinch to zoom. «Show all» adjusts the zoom to show the whole assembly; it never changes output dimensions.

Save PNG saves the assembled image directly. Edit in Paint transfers it into the main editor as an undoable replacement. If the output exceeds the memory budget, choose a smaller output copy if offered. If even a tiny output exceeds the budget, the app shows a memory warning instead of a size chooser. Original source files stay unchanged. The current assembly is stored locally and reopens when you return.

This mode uses the same Catrobat/AGPL and asset credits shown in the main editor's «File > About, licences & credits» panel.
rows.localized:
可使用 Android 的檔案選擇器加入最多 20 張圖片。下方托盤會顯示縮圖、檔案名稱，以及裁剪及「相同闊度」或「相同高度」調整後的圖片尺寸。如檔案提供者有提供修改時間，亦會顯示該時間。你可按檔案名稱或修改時間排序；排序不會重新排列已放置的圖片。

點按縮圖以選取圖片。「裁剪圖片」會裁剪該圖片；「批次裁剪」會以像素或百分比邊距套用至所選圖片。拖動裁剪控制點或輸入數值。「重設裁剪」會還原原來邊緣。裁剪屬非破壞性操作，可復原。

按住縮圖，或拖動工作區內已放置的圖片，再放到反白顯示的邊緣。半透明預覽會顯示準確的貼齊結果。接到右方時會對齊頂端；接到下方時會對齊左邊。你亦可先點按縮圖，再點按「+」目標。第一張圖片由原點開始。裁剪母圖片時，連接到它的圖片可能會移動。不允許圖片互相重疊。

「相同闊度」和「相同高度」會在保留各圖片本身長寬比例的情況下，為所有輸入圖片設定共同尺寸。可選像素、百分比、最小或最大。「還原原本大小」會取消尺寸統一，但保留裁剪。

「取消放置」只會將所選圖片放回托盤。後面的圖片會填補空位，但仍維持已放置狀態。「移除」只會刪除該輸入圖片。「復原／重做」可還原這些變更。拖動已放置圖片可重新排列；拖動空白位置可平移視圖。以雙指縮放。「顯示全部」只會縮放視圖以顯示整個拼合結果，不會改變輸出尺寸。

「儲存 PNG」會直接儲存拼合後的圖片。「在 Paint 編輯」會將圖片傳送到主編輯器，作為可復原的圖片取代操作。如果輸出超出記憶體上限，而應用程式提供了尺寸選擇畫面，請選擇較小的輸出副本。如果連極小的輸出也超出記憶體上限，應用程式會顯示記憶體警告，而不會顯示尺寸選擇畫面。原始圖片檔案不會被修改。目前的拼合狀態會儲存在裝置內，返回此功能時會重新開啟。

此模式使用主編輯器「檔案」>「關於、授權及鳴謝」選單內相同的 Catrobat/AGPL 及素材鳴謝資料。

像素或百分比邊距 and 所選圖片 preserve the unit choices, trimming margins, and selected subset. The technical formulation is compressed but understandable in written HK Chinese; it does not say every image must be cropped.
拖動裁剪控制點或輸入數值 preserves the two input methods without reversing a direction.
重設裁剪 restores original edges; 非破壞性操作，可復原 preserves source immutability and undoability, rather than claiming removal of source-file pixels.

clauses.review: 按住縮圖, 拖動工作區內已放置的圖片 and 放到反白顯示的邊緣 preserve both placement routes. 反白顯示 is the conventional UI sense of highlight, not a claim that a particular white colour is mandatory.
半透明預覽 and 準確的貼齊結果 preserve transparency and the eventual snapped position.

clauses.invariant: Right aligns tops; bottom aligns left edges
clauses.review: 接到右方時會對齊頂端；接到下方時會對齊左邊 preserves both attachment edges and axes. It does not invert or mirror image geometry.

clauses.invariant: Tap plus target and first-image origin
clauses.review: The + target, two-tap route, and first-image origin are all present. 原點 is appropriate geometric terminology in this assembly context.

裁剪母圖片時，連接到它的圖片可能會移動 explicitly names the attached images and says may move. 母圖片 is understandable technical parent terminology, and the following relative phrase disambiguates the relationship. It does not claim the cropped parent always moves or that attachment metadata is reassigned.
不允許圖片互相重疊 retains rejection of overlapping placements; invalid crop updates are also rejected before state is written.

clauses.review: 相同闊度/相同高度 and 保留各圖片本身長寬比例 retain the selected common axis and each image’s own ratio. 共同尺寸 is interpreted in that explicitly named width/height context; it does not instruct users to force identical width AND height.
像素、百分比、最小或最大 preserves all four named choices and matches their HK control labels.
取消尺寸統一，但保留裁剪 accurately separates normalization removal from crop reset; it does not promise restoration of cropped borders.

後面的圖片會填補空位，但仍維持已放置狀態 retains successor promotion and continued placement. 後面的 is intelligible as the following attached images in this context.
只會刪除該輸入圖片 preserves removal of one assembly input; the later original-file sentence prevents confusing this with deleting the user’s source file.
復原／重做 and 還原這些變更 retain reversibility of the described operations and match the actual HK Undo/Redo labels.
拖動已放置圖片可重新排列; 拖動空白位置可平移視圖; 以雙指縮放 preserve the distinct gestures and their targets.

clauses.review: 只會縮放視圖以顯示整個拼合結果，不會改變輸出尺寸 preserves the fit-to-view/output-size distinction. Fit also recentres the view; the wording describes its purpose without claiming output resampling.

clauses.review: 儲存 PNG and 在 Paint 編輯 match current controls. The complete sentence describes transferring the composite to the main editor as an undoable image replacement, not as an extra layer or a destructive source-file edit.
而應用程式提供了尺寸選擇畫面 correctly qualifies the smaller-output instruction. It does not promise that every memory-limit case offers a size chooser.

clauses.review: Width remains argument 1, height argument 2, order and multiplication sign preserved. This is the crop preview rectangle, not the tray’s normalized placedSize.
Argument 3 is the selected-image count; 張 is natural for flat images. The same construction works for zero, one and plural counts.

clauses.source_invariant: Cropping placed images may move their attached images.
clauses.target_clause: 裁剪已放置圖片時，連接到它們的圖片可能會移動。
clauses.review: The cropped images are explicitly already placed; the possibly moving images are explicitly attached to them. 可能會 retains possibility rather than inevitability. Generic 它們 is idiomatic even when the selected count is one.

behavior_summary: ImageAssembly.crop changes crop metadata only; attachment anchor/edge fields are retained. Validation occurs before writing the state.
Layout recomputes child coordinates from the parent placed rectangle: RIGHT uses parent.right and parent.top; BOTTOM uses parent.left and parent.bottom.

For an unnormalized 100×80 parent and 20×30 child: a RIGHT child stays at (100,0) after a height-only crop but moves to (60,0) when parent width becomes 60; a BOTTOM child stays at (0,80) after a width-only crop but moves to (0,50) when parent height becomes 50.
Normalization can keep the attachment-axis dimension fixed and affects the computed other dimension; movement depends on final placedSize, not merely whether crop was invoked.
Overlapping/invalid layouts are rejected atomically. May move is the correct high-level warning; an unconditional moves statement is unsupported.

Crop preview values are crop.width and crop.height. The quantity selector and third formatting argument both use the selected-image count. Zero is displayable in a batch preview but applying an empty selection is rejected.
The Help tray-dimensions clause is distinct: the tray displays post-crop, post-normalization placedSize.
language_assessment: Appropriate written Hong Kong Traditional Chinese, with regionally suitable 闊度, 檔案, 裁剪, 儲存 and 鳴謝. It need not be rewritten into colloquial Cantonese: that is a separate offered catalogue. All quoted commands checked against the current HK resource labels. No required full-text correction identified.
limitations: Static full-text/source-context acceptance only; no whole-catalogue, runtime, installed-device, rendering, font or accessibility acceptance.
No app source, tracker, review counters or repository state were edited or published.
Four processing-label holds are expressly outside scope and remain untouched.
Historical receipts are not silently reactivated. Any tracker successor must attach this current complete-pair review and preserve the source pin.
